Nina is going to travel to London in August. The flower market is one of the best places in the city. Nina spent the weekend at the library. Chimpanzees use sticks to catch termites.
They took many photos at the plant garden. The weather was rainy that day. Nina hopes to visit London one day. What's more, the hurricane destroyed many houses.

Nina thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. It takes twenty minutes to get to the flower market by bike. Nina learned a lot about English. What's more, her apartment in Manhattan is small but very expensive.
Nina plays basketball with Kate every Thursday. Both of them like noodles and coffee. Life is full of small surprises.
